phase: Single-host autonomous fixture build and review foundation
decision_trigger: Local timer consumes only immutable events in this peer's arrived store; observer has no run_action RPC
evidence: Bind complete visible inventory, consumed prerequisites, artifacts, source text, request, policy, role, run and authority profile; freeze one action per slot
authority: peer-authority-v1; separate principal capabilities; common reservations and epoch validation without global state exposure or action selection
recovery: Same claim and dispatch IDs reconcile exact receipts; unknown dispatch retains reservation and is terminal; durable exact outbox uses idempotent event publication
atomicity: Action journal and event store are separate databases with an idempotent outbox; no cross-database transaction claim
telemetry: Durable boot/RPC attempt/reply/error counters and pending transport-error flag; attempts are not commits; base transport byte counters remain per-boot
trust: Trusted host and gossip group; no hostile same-user isolation, independent forwarded receipt signatures, TLS or multi-host failover
remaining: Sandboxed candidate execution and exact merged-source Git CAS
Bounded live deadlines and retry backoff
Durable full transport telemetry and matched capacity
